canonical_relationships.operation: Ensure meal-level protein supply delivers the amino-acid foundation neurotransmitter pathways depend on.

scientific_assessment.operation: Ensure meal-level protein supply delivers the amino-acid foundation neurotransmitter pathways depend on.

functional_dependency.statement: The defined indispensable set must be supplied by diet and supports circulating amino-acid availability. The accepted PM relationship concerns coverage, not increased brain synthesis.

dietary_supply.statement: The canonical milk record explicitly documents a complete essential-amino-acid profile with FAO provenance. A qualitative complete-set edge does not infer quantities from total protein.

scientific_assessment.assessment_limitations: Identity reconciliation of the already accepted class; no new requirement that each meal provide all nine, no uniform digestibility or neurotransmitter benefit.

food_target_research.sufficient_coverage_rationale: Existing canonical Milk text explicitly supports the complete set. Record that supported qualitative relationship; no food is inferred from total protein and no nine-fold multiplication of admissions or amounts is performed. Other full-profile food edges require separate verified composition.

canonical_relationships.biological_role: Coverage of the indispensable amino-acid set, including phenylalanine, that sets the circulating pool neurotransmitter pathways can draw on. Meals contribute measurable amino-acid composition; this is not a requirement that each meal provide complete coverage
canonical_relationships.dietary_input_note: Accepted dietary provision or constituent supply relationship; no efficacy or quantity claim added.
canonical_relationships.limitation: Protein-quality scoring and vegetarian-diet amino-acid coverage do not establish that increasing protein raises brain monoamine synthesis or improves attention or mood. The indispensable set includes phenylalanine; tyrosine is not an indispensable amino acid.
canonical_relationships.qualification: Accepted dietary provision or constituent supply relationship; no efficacy or quantity claim added.

canonical_relationships.operation: Ensure meal-level protein supply delivers the amino-acid foundation neurotransmitter pathways depend on.

scientific_assessment.operation: Ensure meal-level protein supply delivers the amino-acid foundation neurotransmitter pathways depend on.

functional_dependency.statement: Dietary tyrosine supplies the circulating tyrosine precursor pool, alongside endogenous phenylalanine hydroxylation, sustaining substrate availability for downstream pathways.

dietary_supply.statement: The same mineral has established dietary supply through the canonical composition records. Cellular uptake and homeostasis mediate enzyme loading; this is maintenance of capacity, not a claim that extra intake accelerates the reaction.

scientific_assessment.assessment_limitations: Dietary supply to a circulating pool is distinct from brain transport, catecholamine synthesis or clinical benefit. A small human study found higher plasma tyrosine during protein-containing meals and after a large tyrosine supplement; it does not define ordinary-food efficacy or a need for extra tyrosine when supply is adequate. Tyrosine is not an indispensable amino acid.

food_target_research.sufficient_coverage_rationale: Inspected existing structured composition records and provisional research coverage for the same mineral. Verified plant/animal sources are reused with preparation qualifiers; no new food edge, effective food dose or enzyme-response inference is created.

canonical_relationships.biological_role: Catecholamine precursor in the circulating pool this PM prioritises. Tyrosine is normally formed from indispensable phenylalanine and can become conditionally indispensable when phenylalanine availability is limited
canonical_relationships.dietary_input_note: 2026-10-26 recovery: admitted Type A capacity under the functional-dependency and dietary-supply gate. The original biochemical-only record and its rationale are preserved in the recovery history. No additional-intake efficacy is asserted.
canonical_relationships.limitation: Dietary supply to a circulating pool is distinct from brain transport, catecholamine synthesis or clinical benefit. A small human study found higher plasma tyrosine during protein-containing meals and after a large tyrosine supplement; it does not define ordinary-food efficacy or a need for extra tyrosine when supply is adequate. Tyrosine is not an indispensable amino acid.

canonical_relationships.operation: Maintain appropriately regulated dopamine synthesis, storage, release, receptor signalling, reuptake and metabolism across changing functional demand.
canonical_relationships.biological_role: Folate supplies the methyl group through [BRS2 PM1 — Folate/B12 remethylation](/docs/biological-targets/brs2/fm1/brs2-fm1-pm1-folate-b12-dependent-homocysteine-remethylation), replenishing methionine used by [BRS2 PM3 — MAT/SAM synthesis](/docs/biological-targets/brs2/fm1/brs2-fm1-pm3-same-synthesis). SAM is the methyl donor used by COMT during dopamine metabolism.
canonical_relationships.dietary_input_note: Accepted dietary provision or constituent supply relationship; no efficacy or quantity claim added.
canonical_relationships.limitation: This requires functional B12-dependent remethylation. The connected reaction chain does not measure dietary folate contribution to regional brain SAM or clearance; alternative methionine supply and tissue turnover matter. A limiting effect and benefit from extra intake remain unresolved.

canonical_relationships.operation: Maintain appropriately regulated dopamine synthesis, storage, release, receptor signalling, reuptake and metabolism across changing functional demand.
canonical_relationships.biological_role: Betaine donates methyl groups through [BRS2 PM2 — BHMT remethylation](/docs/biological-targets/brs2/fm1/brs2-fm1-pm2-betaine-bhmt-remethylation), predominantly in liver and kidney, replenishing methionine upstream of [BRS2 PM3 — SAM synthesis](/docs/biological-targets/brs2/fm1/brs2-fm1-pm3-same-synthesis). SAM is used by COMT during dopamine metabolism.
canonical_relationships.dietary_input_note: Accepted dietary provision or constituent supply relationship; no efficacy or quantity claim added.
canonical_relationships.limitation: This is peripheral BHMT supply, not neuronal BHMT activity or measured delivery into neural SAM. Dietary methionine and folate remethylation provide alternatives. Homocysteine lowering does not establish regional clearance, a limiting constraint or benefit from extra intake.
canonical_relationships.qualification: Accepted dietary provision or constituent supply relationship; no efficacy or quantity claim added. Supported upstream resource supply; not reclassified as limiting iKC applicability.

canonical_relationships.operation: Maintain appropriately regulated dopamine synthesis, storage, release, receptor signalling, reuptake and metabolism across changing functional demand.
canonical_relationships.biological_role: Choline can be oxidised to betaine for [BRS2 PM2 — BHMT remethylation](/docs/biological-targets/brs2/fm1/brs2-fm1-pm2-betaine-bhmt-remethylation), predominantly in liver and kidney, replenishing methionine upstream of [BRS2 PM3 — SAM synthesis](/docs/biological-targets/brs2/fm1/brs2-fm1-pm3-same-synthesis). SAM is used by COMT during dopamine metabolism.
canonical_relationships.dietary_input_note: Accepted dietary provision or constituent supply relationship; no efficacy or quantity claim added.
canonical_relationships.limitation: Only choline-to-betaine methyl supply is admitted, not membrane or acetylcholine roles. Oxidation, peripheral BHMT, alternative methionine supply and local neural SAM turnover limit interpretation. Neural delivery, increased clearance, a limiting constraint and extra-intake benefit are not measured.

canonical_relationships.biological_role: Phenylalanine is hydroxylated to tyrosine in peripheral tissues, replenishing the circulating tyrosine available to [LAT1 transport](/docs/biological-targets/brs1/fm1/brs1-fm1-pm2-lat1-competitive-transport-modulation) upstream of dopamine synthesis.

canonical_relationships.limitation: Human peripheral conversion supplies circulating tyrosine; neuronal delivery uses the separately supported transport chain. This does not establish increased dopamine/noradrenaline output, a limiting intake or benefit from extra phenylalanine. Hydroxylation, renal/hepatic function and LNAA competition matter; high phenylalanine is not interchangeable with tyrosine.

canonical_relationships.operation: Maintain appropriately regulated dopamine synthesis, storage, release, receptor signalling, reuptake and metabolism across changing functional demand.

scientific_assessment.operation: Maintain appropriately regulated dopamine synthesis, storage, release, receptor signalling, reuptake and metabolism across changing functional demand.
scientific_assessment.assessment_limitations: Rat enzyme capacity, not measured human neurotransmitter clearance, synaptic output or benefit above adequacy. No conclusion about which flavin analogue is effective is taken from the internally inconsistent abstract. The same experiment is shared across the three monoamine PMs, not independent replication.

food_target_research.sufficient_coverage_rationale: Existing structured composition and provisional food research for this exact canonical input were inspected. Reuse these source/form-qualified foods; do not infer an effective food dose or invent additional relationships.

functional_dependency.statement: Riboflavin supplies FMN and FAD formation; FAD sustains monoamine oxidase in dopamine metabolism capacity.

dietary_supply.statement: Food riboflavin supplies the precursor activated by human RFK and FLAD1 to FMN/FAD. Cofactor loading is not increased neurotransmitter output.

conversion_pathway.process: Riboflavin kinase (RFK) phosphorylates riboflavin to FMN using ATP.
conversion_pathway.limitations: Enzyme identity does not quantify tissue cofactor supply or flux after a meal.

evidence.statement: Human RFK catalyses riboflavin phosphorylation; UniProt Q969G6 entry 195 retrieved 2026-10-26, Rhea 14357.

conversion_pathway.process: FLAD1 FAD synthase adenylates FMN with ATP to form FAD.
conversion_pathway.limitations: FAD production and enzyme loading depend on cellular context; no fixed food-to-FAD yield is inferred.

evidence.statement: Human FLAD1 catalyses FMN adenylation; UniProt Q8NFF5 entry 182 retrieved 2026-10-26, Rhea 17237.

canonical_relationships.biological_role: Riboflavin supplies FMN and FAD formation; FAD sustains monoamine oxidase in dopamine metabolism capacity.
canonical_relationships.dietary_input_note: 2026-10-26 mission-specific dietary recovery: admitted under the existing Type A gate; food composition does not establish an effective intervention dose.

canonical_relationships.operation: Support noradrenergic alertness and executive control so attention and arousal stay appropriately engaged.
canonical_relationships.biological_role: Folate supplies the methyl group through [BRS2 PM1 — Folate/B12 remethylation](/docs/biological-targets/brs2/fm1/brs2-fm1-pm1-folate-b12-dependent-homocysteine-remethylation), replenishing methionine used by [BRS2 PM3 — MAT/SAM synthesis](/docs/biological-targets/brs2/fm1/brs2-fm1-pm3-same-synthesis). SAM is the methyl donor used by COMT during noradrenaline metabolism.
canonical_relationships.dietary_input_note: Accepted dietary provision or constituent supply relationship; no efficacy or quantity claim added.
canonical_relationships.limitation: This requires functional B12-dependent remethylation. The connected reaction chain does not measure dietary folate contribution to regional brain SAM or clearance; alternative methionine supply and tissue turnover matter. A limiting effect and benefit from extra intake remain unresolved.

canonical_relationships.operation: Support noradrenergic alertness and executive control so attention and arousal stay appropriately engaged.
canonical_relationships.biological_role: Betaine donates methyl groups through [BRS2 PM2 — BHMT remethylation](/docs/biological-targets/brs2/fm1/brs2-fm1-pm2-betaine-bhmt-remethylation), predominantly in liver and kidney, replenishing methionine upstream of [BRS2 PM3 — SAM synthesis](/docs/biological-targets/brs2/fm1/brs2-fm1-pm3-same-synthesis). SAM is used by COMT during noradrenaline metabolism.
canonical_relationships.dietary_input_note: Accepted dietary provision or constituent supply relationship; no efficacy or quantity claim added.
canonical_relationships.limitation: This is peripheral BHMT supply, not neuronal BHMT activity or measured delivery into neural SAM. Dietary methionine and folate remethylation provide alternatives. Homocysteine lowering does not establish regional clearance, a limiting constraint or benefit from extra intake.
canonical_relationships.qualification: Accepted dietary provision or constituent supply relationship; no efficacy or quantity claim added. Supported upstream resource supply; not reclassified as limiting iKC applicability.

canonical_relationships.biological_role: Phenylalanine is hydroxylated to tyrosine in peripheral tissues, replenishing the circulating tyrosine available to [LAT1 transport](/docs/biological-targets/brs1/fm1/brs1-fm1-pm2-lat1-competitive-transport-modulation) upstream of noradrenaline synthesis.
canonical_relationships.dietary_input_note: Accepted dietary provision or constituent supply relationship; no efficacy or quantity claim added.
canonical_relationships.limitation: Human peripheral conversion supplies circulating tyrosine; neuronal delivery uses the separately supported transport chain. This does not establish increased dopamine/noradrenaline output, a limiting intake or benefit from extra phenylalanine. Hydroxylation, renal/hepatic function and LNAA competition matter; high phenylalanine is not interchangeable with tyrosine.

canonical_relationships.operation: Support noradrenergic alertness and executive control so attention and arousal stay appropriately engaged.

scientific_assessment.operation: Support noradrenergic alertness and executive control so attention and arousal stay appropriately engaged.
scientific_assessment.assessment_limitations: Rat enzyme capacity, not measured human neurotransmitter clearance, synaptic output or benefit above adequacy. No conclusion about which flavin analogue is effective is taken from the internally inconsistent abstract. The same experiment is shared across the three monoamine PMs, not independent replication.

food_target_research.sufficient_coverage_rationale: Existing structured composition and provisional food research for this exact canonical input were inspected. Reuse these source/form-qualified foods; do not infer an effective food dose or invent additional relationships.

functional_dependency.statement: Riboflavin supplies FMN and FAD formation; FAD sustains monoamine oxidase in noradrenaline metabolism capacity.

dietary_supply.statement: Food riboflavin supplies the precursor activated by human RFK and FLAD1 to FMN/FAD. Cofactor loading is not increased neurotransmitter output.

conversion_pathway.process: Riboflavin kinase (RFK) phosphorylates riboflavin to FMN using ATP.
conversion_pathway.limitations: Enzyme identity does not quantify tissue cofactor supply or flux after a meal.

evidence.statement: Human RFK catalyses riboflavin phosphorylation; UniProt Q969G6 entry 195 retrieved 2026-10-26, Rhea 14357.

conversion_pathway.process: FLAD1 FAD synthase adenylates FMN with ATP to form FAD.
conversion_pathway.limitations: FAD production and enzyme loading depend on cellular context; no fixed food-to-FAD yield is inferred.

evidence.statement: Human FLAD1 catalyses FMN adenylation; UniProt Q8NFF5 entry 182 retrieved 2026-10-26, Rhea 17237.

canonical_relationships.operation: Support serotonergic signalling so mood stability, inhibition, and behavioural regulation remain well grounded.

scientific_assessment.operation: Support serotonergic signalling so mood stability, inhibition, and behavioural regulation remain well grounded.
scientific_assessment.assessment_limitations: Rat enzyme capacity, not measured human neurotransmitter clearance, synaptic output or benefit above adequacy. No conclusion about which flavin analogue is effective is taken from the internally inconsistent abstract. The same experiment is shared across the three monoamine PMs, not independent replication.

food_target_research.sufficient_coverage_rationale: Existing structured composition and provisional food research for this exact canonical input were inspected. Reuse these source/form-qualified foods; do not infer an effective food dose or invent additional relationships.

functional_dependency.statement: Riboflavin supplies FMN and FAD formation; FAD sustains monoamine oxidase in serotonin metabolism capacity.

dietary_supply.statement: Food riboflavin supplies the precursor activated by human RFK and FLAD1 to FMN/FAD. Cofactor loading is not increased neurotransmitter output.

conversion_pathway.process: Riboflavin kinase (RFK) phosphorylates riboflavin to FMN using ATP.
conversion_pathway.limitations: Enzyme identity does not quantify tissue cofactor supply or flux after a meal.

evidence.statement: Human RFK catalyses riboflavin phosphorylation; UniProt Q969G6 entry 195 retrieved 2026-10-26, Rhea 14357.

conversion_pathway.process: FLAD1 FAD synthase adenylates FMN with ATP to form FAD.
conversion_pathway.limitations: FAD production and enzyme loading depend on cellular context; no fixed food-to-FAD yield is inferred.

evidence.statement: Human FLAD1 catalyses FMN adenylation; UniProt Q8NFF5 entry 182 retrieved 2026-10-26, Rhea 17237.

canonical_relationships.operation: Maintain the capacity to form acetylcholine so cholinergic signalling for attention, working memory, and learning stays supplied.
canonical_relationships.biological_role: Nutritional precursor of coenzyme A, from which cells form the acetyl-CoA required for acetylcholine synthesis
canonical_relationships.dietary_input_note: Existing biological role explicitly admits the nutritional precursor route to coenzyme A; intracellular reaction participation does not negate that dietary route.
canonical_relationships.limitation: Chronic ethanol-associated pantothenate depletion and rescue affected acetylcholine synthesis in rats; this does not establish that extra B5 raises brain acetylcholine in adequately nourished humans.
canonical_relationships.qualification: Existing biological role explicitly admits the nutritional precursor route to coenzyme A; intracellular reaction participation does not negate that dietary route.

canonical_relationships.operation: Maintain the capacity to form acetylcholine so cholinergic signalling for attention, working memory, and learning stays supplied.
canonical_relationships.biological_role: Folate-dependent methyl metabolism helps maintain the brain choline resource available for acetylcholine formation; folate deprivation lowered choline and acetylcholine in studied mouse models, with SAM rescue supporting this upstream resource relationship.
canonical_relationships.dietary_input_note: Accepted dietary provision or constituent supply relationship; no efficacy or quantity claim added.
canonical_relationships.limitation: Animal evidence is conditional on age, brain region and experimental context. Choline and acetylcholine concentrations were measured; methyl-dependent choline retention and the consequence for synthesis capacity are mechanistic inferences, not measured human synthesis flux. Folate is not a ChAT cofactor; extra folate above adequacy and cognitive benefit are not established.

canonical_relationships.operation: Maintain the capacity to form acetylcholine so cholinergic signalling for attention, working memory, and learning stays supplied.

scientific_assessment.operation: Maintain the capacity to form acetylcholine so cholinergic signalling for attention, working memory, and learning stays supplied.

canonical_relationships.operation: Deliver and integrate DHA into neuronal membranes so the brain maintains a flexible, signal-ready lipid foundation.
canonical_relationships.biological_role: Choline can contribute methyl groups through the upstream methionine/SAM route to [BRS2 PM7 — PEMT-dependent phosphatidylcholine formation](/docs/biological-targets/brs2/fm3/brs2-fm3-pm7-phosphatidylcholine-formation). Methyl-derived LPC-DHA is a carrier used by MFSD2A for brain DHA delivery.
canonical_relationships.dietary_input_note: Accepted dietary provision or constituent supply relationship; no efficacy or quantity claim added.
canonical_relationships.limitation: Human plasma isotopic enrichment is not absolute hepatic flux, net carrier supply or adult neuronal DHA incorporation. Higher choline intake did not increase total plasma LPC-DHA in the feeding study. The carrier-to-brain connection uses separate cell/mouse transport evidence. Donor inadequacy as a limiting constraint, compensation and benefit from extra intake remain unresolved.
canonical_relationships.qualification: Accepted dietary provision or constituent supply relationship; no efficacy or quantity claim added. Supported upstream resource supply; not reclassified as limiting iKC applicability.

canonical_relationships.operation: Deliver and integrate DHA into neuronal membranes so the brain maintains a flexible, signal-ready lipid foundation.
canonical_relationships.biological_role: Folate-derived one-carbon units support [BRS2 PM1 — remethylation](/docs/biological-targets/brs2/fm1/brs2-fm1-pm1-folate-b12-dependent-homocysteine-remethylation), replenishing methionine for SAM-dependent [BRS2 PM7 — PEMT formation](/docs/biological-targets/brs2/fm3/brs2-fm3-pm7-phosphatidylcholine-formation), upstream of DHA-bearing LPC carrier delivery.
canonical_relationships.dietary_input_note: Accepted dietary provision or constituent supply relationship; no efficacy or quantity claim added.
canonical_relationships.limitation: Supported biochemical supply chain, not a demonstrated increase in net adult brain DHA incorporation. Folate/choline compensation, hepatic BHMT, SAM turnover and carrier remodelling vary by context. Mouse folate effects were sex/tissue dependent; betaine rescue used ethanol-exposed rats. The downstream human tracer study administered choline, not folate or betaine. A donor-specific limiting effect and extra-intake benefit remain unresolved.

canonical_relationships.operation: Deliver and integrate DHA into neuronal membranes so the brain maintains a flexible, signal-ready lipid foundation.
canonical_relationships.biological_role: Betaine donates a methyl group through hepatic [BRS2 PM2 — BHMT remethylation](/docs/biological-targets/brs2/fm1/brs2-fm1-pm2-betaine-bhmt-remethylation), replenishing methionine/SAM used by [BRS2 PM7 — PEMT formation](/docs/biological-targets/brs2/fm3/brs2-fm3-pm7-phosphatidylcholine-formation) upstream of DHA-bearing LPC carrier delivery.
canonical_relationships.dietary_input_note: Accepted dietary provision or constituent supply relationship; no efficacy or quantity claim added.
canonical_relationships.limitation: Supported biochemical supply chain, not a demonstrated increase in net adult brain DHA incorporation. Folate/choline compensation, hepatic BHMT, SAM turnover and carrier remodelling vary by context. Mouse folate effects were sex/tissue dependent; betaine rescue used ethanol-exposed rats. The downstream human tracer study administered choline, not folate or betaine. A donor-specific limiting effect and extra-intake benefit remain unresolved.

Brain homeostasis and membrane voltage remain determinants; more NMDA inhibition is not automatically beneficial.

explanation: Covered by verified power-qualified canonical food observations.

canonical_relationships.operation: Maintain sufficient glutamate decarboxylase capacity, and sufficient PLP cofactor to support it, so GABA can be synthesised from glutamate.

scientific_assessment.operation: Maintain sufficient glutamate decarboxylase capacity, and sufficient PLP cofactor to support it, so GABA can be synthesised from glutamate.
scientific_assessment.record_origin: Traceability completion of the preserved historical admission; not a new scientific admission or confidence assessment.

functional_dependency.statement: PLP-dependent GAD catalysis is established; dietary deficiency can reduce rat-brain GAD activity through cofactor depletion. The proposition is capacity, not increased synthesis at sufficient intake.

dietary_supply.statement: Human tracer studies establish utilisation of oral B6, including incomplete availability of PN-glucoside. PDXK and human PNPO experiments support vitamer-specific conversion to PLP; this does not measure neuronal cofactor occupancy.

conversion_pathway.process: Vitamer-specific endogenous activation; alternative ordered routes, not one chemical reaction
dependencies: PNPO and FMN for PNP/PMP routes
conversion_pathway.limitations: Alternative routes distinguish PL phosphorylation from PN/PM phosphorylation followed by oxidation. Total food vitamin B6 does not identify vitamer proportions, effective brain exposure or a predictable PLP yield.

evidence.statement: Human PDXK and PNPO enzymology supports distinct substrate-specific activation routes to the same canonical PLP target.

dependencies: ATP–divalent-metal substrate complex; metal effects depend on assay context
steps.limitations: PN and PM phosphorylation produces PNP and PMP, not PLP directly. In-vitro metal efficacy does not establish a dietary zinc requirement.

evidence.statement: Human PDXK phosphorylates PL, PN and PM to their respective 5-prime phosphates.

canonical_relationships.operation: Recycle homocysteine to methionine through folate and B12 so methyl-donor supply and homocysteine control stay supported.
canonical_relationships.biological_role: Methyl-group donor substrate for methionine synthase. The enzyme transfers that methyl group to homocysteine and releases tetrahydrofolate.
canonical_relationships.dietary_input_note: Foods directly supply preformed 5-methyltetrahydrofolate, including polyglutamated forms deconjugated during intestinal absorption. Other dietary folate forms can supply this target through folate metabolism and MTHFR-dependent conversion. Form-specific presence is supported; total folate values must not be relabelled as 5-MTHF quantities or added to 5-MTHF as a separate independent nutrient supply.
canonical_relationships.limitation: Necessity of 5-methyltetrahydrofolate does not show that raising its intake increases tissue methionine-synthase flux.
canonical_relationships.qualification: Foods directly supply preformed 5-methyltetrahydrofolate, including polyglutamated forms deconjugated during intestinal absorption. Other dietary folate forms can supply this target through folate metabolism and MTHFR-dependent conversion. Form-specific presence is supported; total folate values must not be relabelled as 5-MTHF quantities or added to 5-MTHF as a separate independent nutrient supply.

explanation: Covered by verified power-qualified canonical food observations.

canonical_relationships.operation: Recycle homocysteine to methionine through folate and B12 so methyl-donor supply and homocysteine control stay supported.
canonical_relationships.biological_role: Dietary folate, including folic acid reduced by dihydrofolate reductase, is converted through the folate cycle to 5-methyltetrahydrofolate, the methyl donor used by methionine synthase.
canonical_relationships.dietary_input_note: Dietary applicability is already admitted in the Direct/Derived section. This does not establish ordinary-food equivalence, a quantitative requirement, extra-intake benefit or independent supply of a derived product.
canonical_relationships.limitation: This conversion pathway does not show that increasing folate intake increases tissue remethylation flux. Folic acid lowers blood homocysteine, which is a circulating marker.
canonical_relationships.qualification: Dietary applicability is already admitted in the Direct/Derived section. This does not establish ordinary-food equivalence, a quantitative requirement, extra-intake benefit or independent supply of a derived product. Supported upstream resource supply; not reclassified as limiting iKC applicability.

explanation: Covered by verified power-qualified canonical food observations.

canonical_relationships.operation: Recycle homocysteine to methionine through folate and B12 so methyl-donor supply and homocysteine control stay supported.
canonical_relationships.biological_role: Dietary cobalamin is absorbed and processed intracellularly to the methylcobalamin cofactor used by methionine synthase.
canonical_relationships.dietary_input_note: Dietary applicability is already admitted in the Direct/Derived section. This does not establish ordinary-food equivalence, a quantitative requirement, extra-intake benefit or independent supply of a derived product.
canonical_relationships.limitation: Provision of vitamin B12 does not show that increasing intake raises tissue remethylation flux. Added vitamin B12 further lowered blood homocysteine beyond folic acid in pooled trials, which remains a circulating marker.
canonical_relationships.qualification: Dietary applicability is already admitted in the Direct/Derived section. This does not establish ordinary-food equivalence, a quantitative requirement, extra-intake benefit or independent supply of a derived product.

conversion_pathway.process: Riboflavin kinase (RFK) phosphorylates riboflavin to FMN using ATP.
conversion_pathway.limitations: Enzyme identity does not quantify tissue cofactor supply or flux after a meal.

evidence.statement: Human RFK catalyses riboflavin phosphorylation; UniProt Q969G6 entry 195 retrieved 2026-10-26, Rhea 14357.

conversion_pathway.process: FLAD1 FAD synthase adenylates FMN with ATP to form FAD.
conversion_pathway.limitations: FAD production and enzyme loading depend on cellular context; no fixed food-to-FAD yield is inferred.

explanation: Covered by verified power-qualified canonical food observations.

canonical_relationships.operation: Provide a parallel homocysteine clearance route so methionine and SAMe supply remain resilient when folate demand is high.
canonical_relationships.biological_role: Methyl-donor substrate for BHMT remethylation of homocysteine to methionine
canonical_relationships.dietary_input_note: Dietary applicability is already admitted in the Direct/Derived section. This does not establish ordinary-food equivalence, a quantitative requirement, extra-intake benefit or independent supply of a derived product.
canonical_relationships.limitation: Supplemental betaine lowers plasma homocysteine in healthy adults, but that change does not measure tissue BHMT activity or show a clinical benefit. Human evidence is an eight-man depletion pilot, with the challenge response in four clinically depleted participants; tissue BHMT flux was not measured. Rat donor rescue and specific inhibition support the chain. This does not establish ordinary-diet limitation, response in every tissue or benefit above adequacy. Folate’s indirect constraint on BHMT remains unresolved.
canonical_relationships.qualification: Dietary applicability is already admitted in the Direct/Derived section. This does not establish ordinary-food equivalence, a quantitative requirement, extra-intake benefit or independent supply of a derived product.

limitations: Supplemental betaine lowers plasma homocysteine in healthy adults, but that change does not measure tissue BHMT activity or show a clinical benefit. Human evidence is an eight-man depletion pilot, with the challenge response in four clinically depleted participants; tissue BHMT flux was not measured. Rat donor rescue and specific inhibition support the chain. This does not establish ordinary-diet limitation, response in every tissue or benefit above adequacy. Folate’s indirect constraint on BHMT remains unresolved.

canonical_relationships.operation: Provide a parallel homocysteine clearance route so methionine and SAMe supply remain resilient when folate demand is high.
canonical_relationships.biological_role: Dietary precursor that can be oxidised to betaine, the methyl-donor substrate for BHMT
canonical_relationships.dietary_input_note: Dietary applicability is already admitted in the Direct/Derived section. This does not establish ordinary-food equivalence, a quantitative requirement, extra-intake benefit or independent supply of a derived product.
canonical_relationships.limitation: Choline oxidation can supply betaine, but increasing choline intake has not been shown to increase tissue BHMT flux. Human evidence is an eight-man depletion pilot, with the challenge response in four clinically depleted participants; tissue BHMT flux was not measured. Rat donor rescue and specific inhibition support the chain. This does not establish ordinary-diet limitation, response in every tissue or benefit above adequacy. Folate’s indirect constraint on BHMT remains unresolved.
canonical_relationships.qualification: Dietary applicability is already admitted in the Direct/Derived section. This does not establish ordinary-food equivalence, a quantitative requirement, extra-intake benefit or independent supply of a derived product.

canonical_relationships.operation: Provide a parallel homocysteine clearance route so methionine and SAMe supply remain resilient when folate demand is high.

scientific_assessment.operation: Provide a parallel homocysteine clearance route so methionine and SAMe supply remain resilient when folate demand is high.

functional_dependency.statement: Zinc supplies the catalytic metal that activates the homocysteine thiol in human BHMT; removing enzyme-bound zinc abolishes activity and reconstitution restores it.

dietary_supply.statement: The same mineral has established dietary supply through the canonical composition records. Cellular uptake and homeostasis mediate enzyme loading; this is maintenance of capacity, not a claim that extra intake accelerates the reaction.

scientific_assessment.assessment_limitations: Human purified-enzyme metal removal/reconstitution and ligand mutants establish zinc-dependent capacity. Dietary zinc supplies the same element, but no human extra-intake BHMT flux response, intake threshold or cognitive benefit is established.

food_target_research.sufficient_coverage_rationale: Inspected existing structured composition records and provisional research coverage for the same mineral. Verified plant/animal sources are reused with preparation qualifiers; no new food edge, effective food dose or enzyme-response inference is created.

canonical_relationships.biological_role: Active-site metal that activates the homocysteine thiol during BHMT catalysis
canonical_relationships.dietary_input_note: 2026-10-26 recovery: admitted Type A capacity under the functional-dependency and dietary-supply gate. The original biochemical-only record and its rationale are preserved in the recovery history. No additional-intake efficacy is asserted.

functional_dependency.statement: Magnesium supplies the catalytic ion coordinating ATP-derived phosphate groups in human MAT-dependent SAM formation.

dietary_supply.statement: The same mineral has established dietary supply through the canonical composition records. Cellular uptake and homeostasis mediate enzyme loading; this is maintenance of capacity, not a claim that extra intake accelerates the reaction.

scientific_assessment.assessment_limitations: Human MAT structural and enzymological evidence establishes catalytic capacity. Ordinary food supply is distinct from measured MAT flux; no benefit from additional magnesium in replete people or universal methylation increase is asserted.

canonical_relationships.operation: Maintain methionine adenosyltransferase capacity to convert methionine and ATP into SAMe, sustaining the methyl-donor pool used by downstream methyltransferases.

scientific_assessment.operation: Maintain methionine adenosyltransferase capacity to convert methionine and ATP into SAMe, sustaining the methyl-donor pool used by downstream methyltransferases.

functional_dependency.statement: Potassium supplies the active-site catalytic ion supporting phosphoryl-group positioning in human MAT-dependent SAM formation.

dietary_supply.statement: The same mineral has established dietary supply through the canonical composition records. Cellular uptake and homeostasis mediate enzyme loading; this is maintenance of capacity, not a claim that extra intake accelerates the reaction.

scientific_assessment.assessment_limitations: Human MAT structures establish the specific ion relationship. Physiological potassium homeostasis and tissue uptake intervene; no claim that extra dietary potassium raises SAM flux or improves methylation is established.

food_target_research.sufficient_coverage_rationale: Inspected existing structured composition records and provisional research coverage for the same mineral. Verified plant/animal sources are reused with preparation qualifiers; no new food edge, effective food dose or enzyme-response inference is created.

canonical_relationships.operation: Maintain methionine adenosyltransferase capacity to convert methionine and ATP into SAMe, sustaining the methyl-donor pool used by downstream methyltransferases.
canonical_relationships.biological_role: Folate supplies 5-methyltetrahydrofolate to [PM1 — Folate/B12-dependent remethylation](/docs/biological-targets/brs2/fm1/brs2-fm1-pm1-folate-b12-dependent-homocysteine-remethylation), regenerating methionine that PM3 can use to form SAMe.
canonical_relationships.dietary_input_note: Accepted upstream dietary constituent provision is distinct from the pool/constraint reference. Existing role, conditional scope and limitations remain unchanged.
canonical_relationships.limitation: This is upstream methionine supply, not a MAT substrate or cofactor. The route depends on functional vitamin B12-dependent methionine synthase; alternative methionine supply and tissue context affect its contribution. Increased MAT flux or benefit from extra folate in replete individuals is not established.
canonical_relationships.qualification: Accepted upstream dietary constituent provision is distinct from the pool/constraint reference. Existing role, conditional scope and limitations remain unchanged. Supported upstream resource supply; not reclassified as limiting iKC applicability.

canonical_relationships.operation: Maintain methionine adenosyltransferase capacity to convert methionine and ATP into SAMe, sustaining the methyl-donor pool used by downstream methyltransferases.
canonical_relationships.biological_role: Betaine donates a methyl group through [PM2 — Betaine/BHMT remethylation](/docs/biological-targets/brs2/fm1/brs2-fm1-pm2-betaine-bhmt-remethylation) to regenerate methionine used by PM3.
canonical_relationships.dietary_input_note: Accepted upstream dietary constituent provision is distinct from the pool/constraint reference. Existing role, conditional scope and limitations remain unchanged.
canonical_relationships.limitation: BHMT activity is concentrated mainly in liver and kidney; this is not local BHMT activity in every tissue. Folate-dependent remethylation and dietary methionine provide alternative supply. Homocysteine lowering does not establish increased MAT flux, increased SAMe availability or benefit from extra intake in replete individuals.

canonical_relationships.operation: Maintain methionine adenosyltransferase capacity to convert methionine and ATP into SAMe, sustaining the methyl-donor pool used by downstream methyltransferases.
canonical_relationships.biological_role: Choline can be oxidised to betaine, supplying methyl groups through [PM2 — Betaine/BHMT remethylation](/docs/biological-targets/brs2/fm1/brs2-fm1-pm2-betaine-bhmt-remethylation) for methionine regeneration upstream of PM3.
canonical_relationships.dietary_input_note: Accepted upstream dietary constituent provision is distinct from the pool/constraint reference. Existing role, conditional scope and limitations remain unchanged.
canonical_relationships.limitation: Only the choline-to-betaine methyl-supply route is admitted here, not choline membrane or neurotransmitter roles. Oxidation, predominantly hepatic/renal BHMT activity and alternative supply constrain interpretation. Increased MAT flux, increased SAMe availability or benefit from additional choline in replete individuals is not established.

canonical_relationships.limitation: Added vitamin B12 can lower blood homocysteine further after folic acid. That is a concentration result, not a measured cycle-rate response.

canonical_relationships.operation: Maintain balanced methionine-cycle flux so methionine availability, SAM-dependent methylation, homocysteine recycling and transsulfuration remain coordinated across changing physiological demand.

canonical_relationships.dietary_input_note: Dietary applicability is already admitted in the Direct/Derived section. This does not establish ordinary-food equivalence, a quantitative requirement, extra-intake benefit or independent supply of a derived product.
canonical_relationships.limitation: Riboflavin supports formation of the methyl donor. It is not the cofactor at the methionine-synthase catalytic site, and it has not been shown to change human cycle rates.

canonical_relationships.operation: Maintain balanced methionine-cycle flux so methionine availability, SAM-dependent methylation, homocysteine recycling and transsulfuration remain coordinated across changing physiological demand.
canonical_relationships.biological_role: Betaine donates a methyl group through [PM2 — Betaine/BHMT remethylation](/docs/biological-targets/brs2/fm1/brs2-fm1-pm2-betaine-bhmt-remethylation) to regenerate methionine returned to the integrated methionine cycle.
canonical_relationships.dietary_input_note: Accepted upstream dietary constituent provision is distinct from the pool/constraint reference. Existing role, conditional scope and limitations remain unchanged.
canonical_relationships.limitation: BHMT activity is concentrated mainly in liver and kidney; this is not local BHMT activity in every tissue. Folate-dependent remethylation and dietary methionine provide alternative supply. Homocysteine lowering does not establish increased MAT flux, increased SAMe availability or benefit from extra intake in replete individuals.
canonical_relationships.qualification: Accepted upstream dietary constituent provision is distinct from the pool/constraint reference. Existing role, conditional scope and limitations remain unchanged. Supported upstream resource supply; not reclassified as limiting iKC applicability.

canonical_relationships.operation: Maintain balanced methionine-cycle flux so methionine availability, SAM-dependent methylation, homocysteine recycling and transsulfuration remain coordinated across changing physiological demand.
canonical_relationships.biological_role: Choline can be oxidised to betaine, supplying methyl groups through [PM2 — Betaine/BHMT remethylation](/docs/biological-targets/brs2/fm1/brs2-fm1-pm2-betaine-bhmt-remethylation) for methionine regeneration within the integrated methionine cycle.
canonical_relationships.dietary_input_note: Accepted upstream dietary constituent provision is distinct from the pool/constraint reference. Existing role, conditional scope and limitations remain unchanged.
canonical_relationships.limitation: Only the choline-to-betaine methyl-supply route is admitted here, not choline membrane or neurotransmitter roles. Oxidation, predominantly hepatic/renal BHMT activity and alternative supply constrain interpretation. Increased integrated cycle flux or improved branch balance or benefit from additional choline in replete individuals is not established.

explanation: Covered by verified power-qualified canonical food observations.

canonical_relationships.operation: Divert homocysteine toward cysteine so methylation demand is balanced against sulfur amino-acid and redox needs.
canonical_relationships.biological_role: Active cofactor required by cystathionine beta-synthase and cystathionine gamma-lyase for the homocysteine-to-cysteine conversion.
canonical_relationships.dietary_input_note: Dietary applicability is already admitted in the Direct/Derived section. This does not establish ordinary-food equivalence, a quantitative requirement, extra-intake benefit or independent supply of a derived product.
canonical_relationships.limitation: Purified-enzyme dependence on pyridoxal 5'-phosphate does not show that raising vitamin B6 intake increases cysteine formation in people. Moderate B6 restriction changed cystathionine handling but did not significantly reduce total transsulfuration in the assessed human tracer study.
canonical_relationships.qualification: Dietary applicability is already admitted in the Direct/Derived section. This does not establish ordinary-food equivalence, a quantitative requirement, extra-intake benefit or independent supply of a derived product.

canonical_relationships.operation: Build glutathione from sulfur amino acids so cellular antioxidant defence stays connected to one-carbon metabolism.
canonical_relationships.biological_role: Sulfur-amino-acid substrate joined to glutamate in the first ATP-dependent step of glutathione assembly.
canonical_relationships.dietary_input_note: Dietary applicability is already admitted in the Direct/Derived section. This does not establish ordinary-food equivalence, a quantitative requirement, extra-intake benefit or independent supply of a derived product.
canonical_relationships.limitation: Cysteine is the substrate of the first assembly step. A formula that removed methionine and cysteine together slowed whole-blood synthesis, and that formula also removed methionine. When methionine intake stayed adequate, removing cysteine did not lower red-cell synthesis in young men. This does not show that eating more cysteine, once intake is adequate, raises glutathione synthesis.
canonical_relationships.qualification: Dietary applicability is already admitted in the Direct/Derived section. This does not establish ordinary-food equivalence, a quantitative requirement, extra-intake benefit or independent supply of a derived product.

canonical_relationships.operation: Build glutathione from sulfur amino acids so cellular antioxidant defence stays connected to one-carbon metabolism.

scientific_assessment.operation: Build glutathione from sulfur amino acids so cellular antioxidant defence stays connected to one-carbon metabolism.

functional_dependency.statement: Magnesium supplies the catalytic metal used in ATP-dependent human glutathione-synthetase capacity.

dietary_supply.statement: The same mineral has established dietary supply through the canonical composition records. Cellular uptake and homeostasis mediate enzyme loading; this is maintenance of capacity, not a claim that extra intake accelerates the reaction.

scientific_assessment.assessment_limitations: Human GSS crystallography and cofactor annotation support capacity. The structure contains two magnesium ions; this does not establish a dietary dose, increased blood or neuronal glutathione synthesis, or benefit above adequacy. Original one-per-subunit wording is retained in history rather than used as dietary stoichiometry.

food_target_research.sufficient_coverage_rationale: Inspected existing structured composition records and provisional research coverage for the same mineral. Verified plant/animal sources are reused with preparation qualifiers; no new food edge, effective food dose or enzyme-response inference is created.

canonical_relationships.biological_role: Catalytic magnesium supports ATP-dependent human glutathione-synthetase capacity; the assessed crystal structure contains two magnesium ions.
canonical_relationships.dietary_input_note: 2026-10-26 recovery: admitted Type A capacity under the functional-dependency and dietary-supply gate. The original biochemical-only record and its rationale are preserved in the recovery history. No additional-intake efficacy is asserted.
canonical_relationships.limitation: Human GSS crystallography and cofactor annotation support capacity. The structure contains two magnesium ions; this does not establish a dietary dose, increased blood or neuronal glutathione synthesis, or benefit above adequacy. Original one-per-subunit wording is retained in history rather than used as dietary stoichiometry.

explanation: Covered by verified power-qualified canonical food observations.

canonical_relationships.operation: Build glutathione from sulfur amino acids so cellular antioxidant defence stays connected to one-carbon metabolism.
canonical_relationships.biological_role: Dietary methionine can supply cysteine for glutathione assembly. Methionine is not a substrate of the assembly enzymes.
canonical_relationships.dietary_input_note: Dietary applicability is already admitted in the Direct/Derived section. This does not establish ordinary-food equivalence, a quantitative requirement, extra-intake benefit or independent supply of a derived product.
canonical_relationships.limitation: A formula that removed methionine and cysteine together slowed whole-blood synthesis, so that result does not isolate methionine. In the cysteine-free study, methionine intake stayed adequate and red-cell synthesis did not fall. This does not show that eating more methionine, once intake is adequate, raises glutathione synthesis.

canonical_relationships.operation: Build glutathione from sulfur amino acids so cellular antioxidant defence stays connected to one-carbon metabolism.
canonical_relationships.biological_role: Supplemental cysteine precursor given with glycine to older adults, in whom erythrocyte glutathione synthesis increased.
canonical_relationships.dietary_input_note: Dietary applicability is already admitted in the Direct/Derived section. This does not establish ordinary-food equivalence, a quantitative requirement, extra-intake benefit or independent supply of a derived product.
canonical_relationships.limitation: The synthesis increase was measured in older adults given this precursor together with glycine. It does not show an effect of N-acetylcysteine alone, of ordinary foods, or of supplementation outside that group, and it is not a neuronal or clinical result.

canonical_relationships.limitation: The response was conditional on sex and experimental context. Methyl-derived PC enrichment is not absolute PEMT flux; extra folate above adequacy is not established to enhance formation or cognition.

canonical_relationships.operation: Regulate NF-κB transcriptional tone so pro-inflammatory gene programmes do not fire excessively.
canonical_relationships.biological_role: Cysteine supplies a constituent of glutathione. Glutathione participates in the redox regulation of NF-κB kinase activity and DNA binding; this is upstream resource supply, not a direct NF-κB reaction substrate.
canonical_relationships.dietary_input_note: Accepted upstream dietary constituent provision is distinct from the pool/constraint reference. Existing role, conditional scope and limitations remain unchanged.
canonical_relationships.limitation: This is supported upstream supply, not a demonstrated dietary constraint on NF-κB. Human precursor supplementation measured red-cell glutathione, not NF-κB; cysteine was supplied as N-acetylcysteine together with glycine. Cellular redox studies show context-dependent effects, including inhibition after glutathione depletion or increased extracellular cysteine. Neither individual dietary limitation, brain transfer nor benefit from additional intake is established.
canonical_relationships.qualification: Accepted upstream dietary constituent provision is distinct from the pool/constraint reference. Existing role, conditional scope and limitations remain unchanged. Supported upstream resource supply; not reclassified as limiting iKC applicability.

canonical_relationships.operation: Limit gut-derived endotoxin spillover so barrier dysfunction does not drive systemic inflammatory load.
canonical_relationships.biological_role: Cysteine supplies a constituent of glutathione used in epithelial redox protection. Glutathione prevented oxidant-induced paracellular permeability in a cell model; this supports upstream supply to a barrier-protection route, not a proven dietary reduction in endotoxin spillover.
canonical_relationships.dietary_input_note: Accepted upstream dietary constituent provision is distinct from the pool/constraint reference. Existing role, conditional scope and limitations remain unchanged.
canonical_relationships.limitation: Supported upstream supply through glutathione-dependent epithelial redox protection, not an established dietary constraint on endotoxin spillover. Human precursor tracing measured red-cell glutathione after combined glycine and N-acetylcysteine; epithelial experiments measured oxidant-induced paracellular permeability. In Salmonella-infected rats, glutathione depletion did not increase permeability or bacterial translocation. Neither intestinal precursor inadequacy, individual constituent limitation, human LPS reduction nor benefit from additional intake is established.
canonical_relationships.qualification: Accepted upstream dietary constituent provision is distinct from the pool/constraint reference. Existing role, conditional scope and limitations remain unchanged. Supported upstream resource supply; not reclassified as limiting iKC applicability.

canonical_relationships.biological_role: Modulates KEAP1-mediated control of Nrf2, promoting antioxidant-response gene transcription. Human dietary exposure increased Nrf2-associated phase II enzyme RNA in nasal lavage cells.
canonical_relationships.dietary_input_note: Admitted as a nonessential food-derived Direct Regulatory Modulator, not a nutrient requirement. Dietary delivery and human peripheral target engagement are preparation-specific; the compound is the lever.
canonical_relationships.limitation: Human target engagement varies by formulation, tissue and population. The positive study used a myrosinase-completed broccoli sprout homogenate for three days in healthy nonsmokers and measured nasal phase II enzyme RNA, not Nrf2 protein or nuclear translocation. Extract capsules did not increase lung target-gene expression in COPD. An ordinary broccoli meal, direct activation of Nrf2 in the human brain and clinical ADHD benefit remain unestablished. Sulforaphane is not an essential nutrient.

presence_records.evidence: Okunade, Niranjan, Ghawi, Kuhnle and Methven (2018), Molecular Nutrition & Food Research 62:1700980. Formation identity also rests on Fahey et al. (1997).
presence_records.limitations: Sulforaphane forms from glucoraphanin when myrosinase is active. In one cooked-broccoli study the amount depended on preparation, and it is not entered as a per-100 g nutrient.

presence_records.label: Sulforaphane
presence_records.public_note: One UK broccoli lot, cooked sous vide at 100 °C for 20 minutes, formed 1.06 µmol sulforaphane per g dry weight. Adding 1 g brown mustard powder raised that to 8.58 µmol/g dry weight. Twelve adults who ate 200 g excreted 9.8 µmol sulforaphane-NAC per g creatinine in 24 hours, and 44.7 µmol/g creatinine with the mustard. These figures are not a sulforaphane amount for every 100 g of broccoli.
presence_records.source_note: Okunade et al. (2018), Molecular Nutrition & Food Research 62:1700980, Table 1 and the 24-hour urine result. Table 1, µmol sulforaphane per g dry weight: raw 2.05 ± 0.25; sous vide 100 °C for 20 minutes 1.06 ± 0.18; the same cooked broccoli plus 1 g brown mustard powder 8.58 ± 0.33. 8.58 / 1.06 = 8.1, which the paper reports as an 8-fold increase. One results sentence prints the mustard result as 8.58 ± 0.13; the table figure is used here. Urine, 12 adults, 200 g of that cooked broccoli: 9.8 ± 5.1 µmol sulforaphane-NAC per g creatinine in 24 hours without mustard, and 44.7 ± 33.9 with 1 g mustard. 44.7 / 9.8 = 4.6 from the published means. The paper's average of each person's increase is 4.7-fold, with individual increases from 1.7-fold to 10-fold. Sous-vide myrosinase loss in the same paper: 40% after 2 minutes, 90% after 6 minutes, and no measurable activity after 8 minutes. The study did not report a glucoraphanin concentration, and the dry-weight results are not converted to a fresh 100 g amount. Fahey et al. (1997) identifies sulforaphane as the myrosinase product of glucoraphanin; it is not the source of these figures.

calculation.not_a_panel_amount: Dry-weight and creatinine-normalised study results. No moisture figure is given, so they are not scaled to per 100 g fresh broccoli.

canonical_relationships.operation: Balance reactive oxygen species production and clearance so net oxidative pressure stays within tolerable limits.
canonical_relationships.biological_role: Selenocysteine source for glutathione peroxidase, which clears hydroperoxides
canonical_relationships.dietary_input_note: Dietary applicability is already admitted in the Direct/Derived section. This does not establish ordinary-food equivalence, a quantitative requirement, extra-intake benefit or independent supply of a derived product.
canonical_relationships.limitation: In selenium-deficient adults, plasma glutathione peroxidase activity levelled off once intake reached about 35 micrograms a day. Intake above that plateau did not raise the enzyme further, and the study did not measure net oxidative pressure.

explanation: Covered by verified power-qualified canonical food observations.

canonical_relationships.operation: Balance reactive oxygen species production and clearance so net oxidative pressure stays within tolerable limits.

scientific_assessment.operation: Balance reactive oxygen species production and clearance so net oxidative pressure stays within tolerable limits.

functional_dependency.statement: Zinc supplies the structural metal stabilising human SOD1, supporting native Cu/Zn-SOD capacity; copper is the redox-active catalytic metal.

dietary_supply.statement: The same mineral has established dietary supply through the canonical composition records. Cellular uptake and homeostasis mediate enzyme loading; this is maintenance of capacity, not a claim that extra intake accelerates the reaction.

scientific_assessment.assessment_limitations: Curated human SOD1 and experimental structural evidence support a structural capacity relationship, not zinc-dependent catalysis identical to copper. Human dietary SOD responses vary by isoform and status; extra zinc can disturb copper availability. No general oxidative-stress improvement or benefit above adequacy is established.

food_target_research.sufficient_coverage_rationale: Inspected existing structured composition records and provisional research coverage for the same mineral. Verified plant/animal sources are reused with preparation qualifiers; no new food edge, effective food dose or enzyme-response inference is created.

canonical_relationships.biological_role: Structural metal in cytosolic copper-zinc superoxide dismutase
canonical_relationships.dietary_input_note: 2026-10-26 recovery: admitted Type A capacity under the functional-dependency and dietary-supply gate. The original biochemical-only record and its rationale are preserved in the recovery history. No additional-intake efficacy is asserted.
canonical_relationships.limitation: Curated human SOD1 and experimental structural evidence support a structural capacity relationship, not zinc-dependent catalysis identical to copper. Human dietary SOD responses vary by isoform and status; extra zinc can disturb copper availability. No general oxidative-stress improvement or benefit above adequacy is established.

canonical_relationships.operation: Balance reactive oxygen species production and clearance so net oxidative pressure stays within tolerable limits.

scientific_assessment.operation: Balance reactive oxygen species production and clearance so net oxidative pressure stays within tolerable limits.

functional_dependency.statement: Manganese is the catalytic metal of human mitochondrial SOD2. Dietary manganese depletion lowered measured heart and kidney MnSOD activity in rats; this supports capacity supply, not extra-intake optimisation.

dietary_supply.statement: Existing structured manganese composition records supply the same element; enzyme loading and tissue transport remain biological dependencies, with no food-efficacy extrapolation.

scientific_assessment.assessment_limitations: Human SOD2 requires manganese; dietary depletion experiments measured lower heart and kidney MnSOD activity in rats. This establishes a bounded enzyme-capacity dependency, not a human dose recommendation, universal tissue response, measured net ROS balance or benefit above adequate intake.

food_target_research.sufficient_coverage_rationale: The existing manganese ontology already provides verified foods. This review reuses them without creating new edges or treating a food amount as a measured enzyme response.

canonical_relationships.biological_role: Catalytic metal in mitochondrial manganese superoxide dismutase
canonical_relationships.dietary_input_note: 2026-10-26: Type A capacity supply admitted after dietary manganese depletion evidence was assessed separately from absence of a human supplementation response. Original No decision and text retained in recovery history.
canonical_relationships.limitation: Human SOD2 requires manganese; dietary depletion experiments measured lower heart and kidney MnSOD activity in rats. canonical_relationships.operation: Balance reactive oxygen species production and clearance so net oxidative pressure stays within tolerable limits.

scientific_assessment.operation: Balance reactive oxygen species production and clearance so net oxidative pressure stays within tolerable limits.
scientific_assessment.assessment_limitations: Rat diet and tissue context; the kidney result is not a uniform response across organs or a human intake threshold. Human catalase haem identity supports capacity, not benefit from extra iron. Iron can also promote non-enzymatic oxidation; higher catalase activity is not a clinical benefit.

food_target_research.sufficient_coverage_rationale: Existing structured composition and provisional food research for this exact canonical input were inspected. Reuse these source/form-qualified foods; do not infer an effective food dose or invent additional relationships.

functional_dependency.statement: Iron supplies haem-bound catalytic capacity for catalase-mediated hydrogen-peroxide clearance; this does not imply that extra iron improves net redox balance.

dietary_supply.statement: Existing food-composition records supply iron; host haem synthesis and catalase loading are necessary. Ordinary food presence does not establish increased peroxide clearance or an effective dose.

canonical_relationships.biological_role: Iron supplies haem-bound catalytic capacity for catalase-mediated hydrogen-peroxide clearance; this does not imply that extra iron improves net redox balance.
canonical_relationships.dietary_input_note: 2026-10-26 mission-specific dietary recovery: admitted under the existing Type A gate; food composition does not establish an effective intervention dose.
canonical_relationships.limitation: Rat diet and tissue context; the kidney result is not a uniform response across organs or a human intake threshold. Human catalase haem identity supports capacity, not benefit from extra iron. Iron can also promote non-enzymatic oxidation; higher catalase activity is not a clinical benefit.

canonical_relationships.operation: Regenerate vitamin and thiol antioxidants across networked systems so endogenous defence capacity is sustained.
canonical_relationships.biological_role: Reduces the vitamin E radical so vitamin E can keep working. This is regeneration, not the chain-breaking job in the membrane.
canonical_relationships.dietary_input_note: Dietary applicability is already admitted in the Direct/Derived section. This does not establish ordinary-food equivalence, a quantitative requirement, extra-intake benefit or independent supply of a derived product.
canonical_relationships.limitation: Pulse radiolysis shows ascorbate reacting with the vitamin E radical. It does not show that more vitamin C speeds recycling in people.
canonical_relationships.qualification: Dietary applicability is already admitted in the Direct/Derived section. This does not establish ordinary-food equivalence, a quantitative requirement, extra-intake benefit or independent supply of a derived product.

explanation: Covered by verified power-qualified canonical food observations.

canonical_relationships.operation: Regenerate vitamin and thiol antioxidants across networked systems so endogenous defence capacity is sustained.

scientific_assessment.operation: Regenerate vitamin and thiol antioxidants across networked systems so endogenous defence capacity is sustained.

functional_dependency.statement: FAD is the prosthetic cofactor of human glutathione reductase. Human red-cell assays and oral riboflavin experiments support a dietary flavin supply dependency for this thiol-regeneration operation.

dietary_supply.statement: Existing verified riboflavin food records supply the vitamin precursor; RFK and FLAD1 establish its endogenous activation. Food composition is not an efficacy claim.

conversion_pathway.process: Riboflavin kinase (RFK) phosphorylates riboflavin to FMN using ATP.
conversion_pathway.limitations: Enzyme identity does not quantify tissue cofactor supply or flux after a meal.

evidence.statement: Human RFK catalyses riboflavin phosphorylation; UniProt Q969G6 entry 195 retrieved 2026-10-26, Rhea 14357.

conversion_pathway.process: FLAD1 FAD synthase adenylates FMN with ATP to form FAD.
conversion_pathway.limitations: FAD production and enzyme loading depend on cellular context; no fixed food-to-FAD yield is inferred.

evidence.statement: Human FLAD1 catalyses FMN adenylation; UniProt Q8NFF5 entry 182 retrieved 2026-10-26, Rhea 17237.

scientific_assessment.assessment_limitations: Human red-cell enzyme evidence supports flavin-dependent capacity. It does not establish neuronal or whole-body recycling flux, benefit above adequacy, or equivalence between an ordinary food and a 5 mg/day supplement.

canonical_relationships.operation: Tune downstream cytokine signalling intensity so inflammatory tone does not remain chronically elevated.

scientific_assessment.operation: Tune downstream cytokine signalling intensity so inflammatory tone does not remain chronically elevated.
scientific_assessment.assessment_limitations: Fifteen male soccer players, eight weeks, 1.16 g DHA/day in a matched beverage comparison. Ex-vivo stimulated production is not resting circulating signalling, receptor response or universal anti-inflammatory benefit. canonical_relationships.operation: Sustain efficient electron transport so mitochondria generate ATP without excessive electron leakage.
canonical_relationships.biological_role: Flavin mononucleotide (FMN) accepts electrons from NADH at the start of complex I.
canonical_relationships.dietary_input_note: Dietary applicability is already admitted in the Direct/Derived section. This does not establish ordinary-food equivalence, a quantitative requirement, extra-intake benefit or independent supply of a derived product.
canonical_relationships.limitation: The review identifies the cofactor. It does not show that flavin mononucleotide (FMN) supply limits complex I in ordinary life, or that raising intake increases electron transport.
canonical_relationships.qualification: Dietary applicability is already admitted in the Direct/Derived section. This does not establish ordinary-food equivalence, a quantitative requirement, extra-intake benefit or independent supply of a derived product.

explanation: Covered by verified power-qualified canonical food observations.

canonical_relationships.operation: Sustain efficient electron transport so mitochondria generate ATP without excessive electron leakage.

scientific_assessment.operation: Sustain efficient electron transport so mitochondria generate ATP without excessive electron leakage.

functional_dependency.statement: Copper supplies the CuA/CuB centres required for complex-IV electron transfer and oxygen reduction. Dietary copper deficiency impairs cardiac cytochrome-c-oxidase capacity in rats.

dietary_supply.statement: The same mineral has established dietary supply through the canonical composition records. Cellular uptake and homeostasis mediate enzyme loading; this is maintenance of capacity, not a claim that extra intake accelerates the reaction.

scientific_assessment.assessment_limitations: Specific complex-IV metal dependence and dietary-deficiency evidence support capacity supply. Rat cardiac protein/activity effects are not a human optimisation dose, a universal tissue response or proof that extra copper improves electron transport when status is adequate.

food_target_research.sufficient_coverage_rationale: Inspected existing structured composition records and provisional research coverage for the same mineral. Verified plant/animal sources are reused with preparation qualifiers; no new food edge, effective food dose or enzyme-response inference is created.

canonical_relationships.biological_role: Complex IV uses two copper centres while it passes electrons to oxygen.
canonical_relationships.dietary_input_note: 2026-10-26 recovery: admitted Type A capacity under the functional-dependency and dietary-supply gate. The original biochemical-only record and its rationale are preserved in the recovery history. No additional-intake efficacy is asserted.
canonical_relationships.limitation: Specific complex-IV metal dependence and dietary-deficiency evidence support capacity supply. Rat cardiac protein/activity effects are not a human optimisation dose, a universal tissue response or proof that extra copper improves electron transport when status is adequate.
canonical_relationships.qualification: 2026-10-26 recovery: admitted Type A capacity under the functional-dependency and dietary-supply gate. The original biochemical-only record and its rationale are preserved in the recovery history. No additional-intake efficacy is asserted.

explanation: Covered by verified power-qualified canonical food observations.

canonical_relationships.operation: Maintain endogenous Coenzyme Q synthesis, maturation and pool availability to support mitochondrial electron transfer and cellular redox functions.

scientific_assessment.operation: Maintain endogenous Coenzyme Q synthesis, maturation and pool availability to support mitochondrial electron transfer and cellular redox functions.
scientific_assessment.assessment_limitations: Capacity admission only: no CoQ-specific intake target, rate limitation under adequate nutrition, increased synthesis from extra intake, mitochondrial delivery or clinical benefit is established. Endogenous phenylalanine conversion is an alternative source; the full human intervening enzyme sequence remains incompletely assigned.

functional_dependency.statement: Tyrosine supplies quinone-head carbon through the HPDL-associated 4-HMA/4-HB pathway.

dietary_supply.statement: Existing canonical food composition records establish dietary provision of this named nutrient, independently of its CoQ role.

food_target_research.sufficient_coverage_rationale: Reused existing amino-acid, riboflavin and iron composition records with original food-state and measurement provenance. No food is claimed to supply a mitochondrial dose or contain the downstream intracellular product because of precursor presence. No new nutrient concentration is inferred.

conversion_pathway.process: Tyrosine-derived headgroup carbon enters CoQ10 through 4-HPP, HPDL-associated 4-HMA and 4-HB formation followed by prenylation and COQ maturation; this is a net precursor relationship, not an assertion that all intervening human enzymes are assigned.
conversion_pathway.limitations: Capacity admission only: no CoQ-specific intake target, rate limitation under adequate nutrition, increased synthesis from extra intake, mitochondrial delivery or clinical benefit is established. Endogenous phenylalanine conversion is an alternative source; the full human intervening enzyme sequence remains incompletely assigned.

evidence.statement: Human-cell isotope tracing and genetic rescue support net tyrosine contribution; no dietary conversion yield is assumed.

canonical_relationships.operation: Maintain NAD⁺ availability so redox reactions and mitochondrial signalling stay adequately powered.
canonical_relationships.biological_role: Nicotinamide is the salvage substrate that NAMPT recycles toward NAD⁺.
canonical_relationships.dietary_input_note: Dietary applicability is already admitted in the Direct/Derived section. This does not establish ordinary-food equivalence, a quantitative requirement, extra-intake benefit or independent supply of a derived product.
canonical_relationships.limitation: The review identifies the salvage substrate. It does not show that eating more nicotinamide, once intake is adequate, raises NAD⁺. The myopathy niacin study used nicotinic acid at pharmacological doses.
canonical_relationships.qualification: Dietary applicability is already admitted in the Direct/Derived section. This does not establish ordinary-food equivalence, a quantitative requirement, extra-intake benefit or independent supply of a derived product.

canonical_relationships.operation: Maintain NAD⁺ availability so redox reactions and mitochondrial signalling stay adequately powered.
canonical_relationships.input: Nicotinic acid (a form of vitamin B3)
canonical_relationships.biological_role: Nicotinic acid is the Preiss–Handler substrate that cells convert toward NAD⁺.
canonical_relationships.dietary_input_note: Dietary applicability is already admitted in the Direct/Derived section. This does not establish ordinary-food equivalence, a quantitative requirement, extra-intake benefit or independent supply of a derived product.
canonical_relationships.limitation: In five adults with mitochondrial myopathy, niacin at 750–1,000 mg/day raised blood NAD⁺ and brought muscle NAD⁺ to the control level. That is medical dosing in a deficiency disease, not a result for adequate everyday intake, and attention was not measured.
canonical_relationships.qualification: Dietary applicability is already admitted in the Direct/Derived section. This does not establish ordinary-food equivalence, a quantitative requirement, extra-intake benefit or independent supply of a derived product.

canonical_relationships.operation: Maintain NAD⁺ availability so redox reactions and mitochondrial signalling stay adequately powered.
canonical_relationships.biological_role: The liver can convert tryptophan to nicotinamide, which other cells salvage into NAD⁺.
canonical_relationships.dietary_input_note: Dietary applicability is already admitted in the Direct/Derived section. This does not establish ordinary-food equivalence, a quantitative requirement, extra-intake benefit or independent supply of a derived product.
canonical_relationships.limitation: Most cells outside the liver do not run the full route. The review does not establish what share of the NAD⁺ pool comes from tryptophan, and eating more protein is not shown to raise NAD⁺.
canonical_relationships.qualification: Dietary applicability is already admitted in the Direct/Derived section. This does not establish ordinary-food equivalence, a quantitative requirement, extra-intake benefit or independent supply of a derived product.

canonical_relationships.operation: Maintain NAD⁺ availability so redox reactions and mitochondrial signalling stay adequately powered.

scientific_assessment.operation: Maintain NAD⁺ availability so redox reactions and mitochondrial signalling stay adequately powered.
scientific_assessment.assessment_limitations: Supplemental NR chloride at 100–1000 mg is not an effective milk dose. Blood responses do not establish neuronal or mitochondrial NAD delivery, redox flux, superiority to adequate niacin or clinical benefit. Intestinal metabolism and tissue salvage can differ from the displayed intracellular NRK route; other NAD precursors remain alternatives.

food_target_research.sufficient_coverage_rationale: Primary milk analysis and the canonical Milk record were inspected. A qualitative cow-milk NR relationship is recorded with source/material limits; no concentration is transplanted into the USDA whole-milk nutrition table. No NR edge is inferred for plant milks, cheese or other dairy without evidence.

functional_dependency.statement: Dietary nicotinamide riboside can supply the NAD precursor pool through supported salvage reactions, sustaining NAD-availability capacity.

dietary_supply.statement: Primary chemical analysis identifies NR in raw and commercial cow milk. This establishes dietary occurrence, separately from oral supplement-induced blood NAD responses.

conversion_pathway.process: Human NRK1 phosphorylates beta-NR to beta-NMN using ATP.
conversion_pathway.limitations: An established intracellular route is not proof that all oral NR reaches each tissue intact; parallel degradation/salvage can contribute.

evidence.statement: NRK1 curated reaction, entry version 170, Rhea 14017, retrieved 26 October 2026.

conversion_pathway.process: NMN adenylyltransferase adenylates oxidised beta-NMN with ATP to form oxidised NAD.
conversion_pathway.limitations: NMNAT1 establishes reaction identity; other isoforms/transport determine compartmental provision. No fixed dietary conversion yield or mitochondrial/brain endpoint is inferred.

evidence.statement: Human NMNAT1, entry version 202, Rhea 21360, retrieved 26 October 2026.

canonical_relationships.operation: Enable rapid ATP buffering so high-energy-demand tissues can meet sudden metabolic spikes.
canonical_relationships.biological_role: Creatine accepts and donates phosphate through the reversible creatine-kinase reaction, forming the phosphocreatine reserve used for rapid ATP buffering.
canonical_relationships.dietary_input_note: Dietary applicability is already admitted in the Direct/Derived section. This does not establish ordinary-food equivalence, a quantitative requirement, extra-intake benefit or independent supply of a derived product.
canonical_relationships.limitation: The brain also synthesises creatine, and exogenous exposure produces smaller and less consistent cerebral responses than skeletal-muscle responses.
