canonical_relationships.operation: Enable rapid ATP buffering so high-energy-demand tissues can meet sudden metabolic spikes.

scientific_assessment.operation: Enable rapid ATP buffering so high-energy-demand tissues can meet sudden metabolic spikes.

functional_dependency.statement: Arginine supplies a co-substrate for AGAT-dependent guanidinoacetate formation, followed by GAMT-dependent creatine production.

dietary_supply.statement: Canonical Arginine composition records establish dietary amino-acid provision. Endogenous synthesis and homeostasis also contribute; dietary supply is not a claim of current deficiency or benefit above adequacy.

conversion_pathway.process: Human AGAT transfers the amidino group of arginine to glycine, yielding guanidinoacetate and ornithine.
conversion_pathway.limitations: Both co-substrates are required; this is not a fixed dietary yield or an assertion that extra intake is rate-limiting.

evidence.statement: UniProt P50440 entry version 227, Rhea 13201; human renal GAA production independently measured.

conversion_pathway.process: GAMT methylates guanidinoacetate using S-adenosylmethionine to form creatine.
dependencies: Interorgan exchange and receiving-tissue creatine transport
conversion_pathway.limitations: Reaction identity does not prove dietary precursor limitation or cerebral delivery; SAM participation creates no independent methionine admission.

evidence.statement: UniProt Q14353 entry version 215, Rhea 10656.

scientific_assessment.assessment_limitations: Capacity of the endogenous synthesis route is distinct from a claim that extra amino-acid intake raises cerebral creatine, phosphocreatine buffering or cognition. AGAT feedback, GAMT methyl supply, organ exchange and SLC6A8-mediated tissue transport constrain delivery. Human renal GAA production is not a measurement of brain synthesis flux; rat arginine infusion and glycine null responses are not oral human efficacy experiments.

food_target_research.sufficient_coverage_rationale: Existing canonical amino-acid food composition is reused; no food is relabelled as containing GAA or extra creatine, and no dose equivalence is inferred.

canonical_relationships.operation: Enable long-chain fatty-acid transport into mitochondria so fat-derived ATP production can proceed.

scientific_assessment.operation: Enable long-chain fatty-acid transport into mitochondria so fat-derived ATP production can proceed.

functional_dependency.statement: The shuttle reaction uses L-carnitine to transfer long-chain acyl groups; enzyme-function evidence and versioned reaction annotation establish the PM-specific dependency.

dietary_supply.statement: Directly measured food L-carnitine supplies the same substrate; no conversion from total protein or generalisation of a supplemental effect is used.

scientific_assessment.assessment_limitations: Functional dependency and food composition support Capacity, not a need to increase intake. Endogenous synthesis, tissue uptake and conservation also sustain the pool. The existing extracted carnitine/carbohydrate intervention is formulation-specific; meat or dairy effects on transport flux, brain function or ADHD are not established.

targeted_searches.query: Demarquoy radioisotopic free L-carnitine beef lamb dairy food samples; canonical L/(R) identity
targeted_searches.outcome: Primary publisher text explicitly identifies beef/lamb samples. Two qualitative provisional sources; exact preparation/cut unresolved. No kefir or blanket dairy edge created.

canonical_relationships.biological_role: L-carnitine accepts and releases fatty-acyl groups in the mitochondrial shuttle, sustaining long-chain fatty-acid entry for oxidation. Dietary L-carnitine supplies this same circulating substrate alongside endogenous synthesis.
canonical_relationships.dietary_input_note: 2026-10-23: authorised Type A Capacity / Direct admission. Provision is distinct from incremental benefit or dietary indispensability.

explanation: Covered by verified power-qualified canonical food observations.

canonical_relationships.operation: Enable mitochondrial ketone utilisation so alternative fuel is available when glucose conditions shift.

scientific_assessment.operation: Enable mitochondrial ketone utilisation so alternative fuel is available when glucose conditions shift.
scientific_assessment.assessment_limitations: Uncontrolled sequential exposure: C8/C10 mixture (n=11) then 95% tricaprylin (n=6), 30 g/day for one month each. No claim of isolated C8 superiority, cognitive efficacy, healthy-person requirement or ordinary coconut-oil equivalence. PET uptake/metabolism is not a direct cellular ATP assay; no food-effective dose or fixed conversion yield is inferred.

food_target_research.sufficient_coverage_rationale: Inspected MCT Oil’s analytical product-specific triglyceride relationship and Coconut Oil’s explicit distinction between fatty-acid composition and individual triglycerides. Reuse only supported structured or independently researched material edges, retain formulation qualifiers and missing quantities; do not create a coconut-oil trioctanoin edge from C8 fatty-acid content.

functional_dependency.statement: Defined dietary caprylic triglyceride can supply hepatic ketone production and cerebral ketone-fuel availability for this ketone-utilisation operation.

dietary_supply.statement: The primary experiment used an orally administered tricaprylin-rich preparation. The MCT Oil record has a product/preparation-dependent caprylic-triglyceride relationship; fatty-acid content alone is not proof of trioctanoin content.

conversion_pathway.process: Digestive lipolysis releases C8 fatty acid from trioctanoin; the absorbed fatty acid is represented as octanoate at physiological pH.
conversion_pathway.limitations: The C8 acyl form is not free octanoate content in food. Mixed-chain MCT products have formulation-dependent composition.

evidence.statement: Human triglyceride-lipase reaction provenance and the defined oral tricaprylin exposure; retrieved 26 October 2026.

conversion_pathway.process: Hepatic fatty-acid activation and successive mitochondrial beta-oxidation reactions generate acetyl-CoA from the C8 chain.
conversion_pathway.limitations: This is a multireaction biological process, not a single chemical reaction. Tissue partitioning and energy state prevent a fixed food-to-acetyl-CoA yield. Cofactor participation creates no separate dietary admissions.

evidence.statement: Human medium-chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase establishes the initial beta-oxidation reaction; the clinical exposure additionally measures downstream ketone provision.

conversion_pathway.process: Hepatic mitochondrial ketogenesis proceeds through acetoacetyl-CoA formation, HMG-CoA synthase and HMG-CoA lyase to produce acetoacetate.
dependencies: Ketone release, circulation and brain monocarboxylate transport
conversion_pathway.limitations: The endogenous product can interconvert with beta-hydroxybutyrate, but the target identity here is acetoacetate. Ketogenesis, cerebral uptake and ATP production are distinct; no fixed yield or universal benefit is inferred.

evidence.statement: Curated human ACAT1, HMGCS2 and HMGCL reactions, retrieved 26 October 2026.

canonical_relationships.biological_role: Defined dietary caprylic triglyceride can supply hepatic ketone production and cerebral ketone-fuel availability for this ketone-utilisation operation.
canonical_relationships.dietary_input_note: 2026-10-26 mission-specific dietary recovery: admitted under the existing Type A gate; food composition does not establish an effective intervention dose.
canonical_relationships.limitation: Uncontrolled sequential exposure: C8/C10 mixture (n=11) then 95% tricaprylin (n=6), 30 g/day for one month each. No claim of isolated C8 superiority, cognitive efficacy, healthy-person requirement or ordinary coconut-oil equivalence. PET uptake/metabolism is not a direct cellular ATP assay; no food-effective dose or fixed conversion yield is inferred.
canonical_relationships.qualification: 2026-10-26 mission-specific dietary recovery: admitted under the existing Type A gate; food composition does not establish an effective intervention dose.

functional_dependency.statement: Glutamine availability sustains epithelial junction-related cellular capacity; cell perturbations distinguish this from systemic inflammation.

scientific_assessment.assessment_limitations: Cell deprivation including endogenous-synthesis blockade is not ordinary human nutritional deficiency; culture exposure is not a food dose. Selected clinical population and supplemental free glutamine. Neither ordinary-food equivalence nor benefit in healthy people, brain function or ADHD is established.

canonical_relationships.biological_role: Enterocyte metabolic substrate supporting epithelial proliferation, repair, and tight-junction protein maintenance.
canonical_relationships.dietary_input_note: 2026-10-23: previously Unset supply decision completed under the documented Capacity gate. Original atom and note are preserved in the immutable assessment baseline. Supplemental exposure is not ordinary-food efficacy.

The new Capacity assessment admits supply to junction-supporting cellular capacity, without asserting universal dietary limitation, benefit from extra intake, or equivalence to the supplemental exposure.

functional_dependency.statement: Inulin supplies beta-(2,1)-linked fructan substrate to microbes with the corresponding utilisation machinery, supporting this glycan-processing capacity.

dietary_supply.statement: Oral long-chain inulin is a tested dietary exposure. Primary plant chain-length measurements independently support qualitative inulin source research; vegetable consumption has not been shown equivalent to the purified intervention.

targeted_searches.query: Inulin food composition, chemical form and preparation; distinguish tested formulation
targeted_searches.outcome: Primary chain-length measurements support preparation-qualified chicory-root/Jerusalem-artichoke candidates. Generic fructan labels do not establish long-chain inulin.

scientific_assessment.assessment_limitations: Utilisation genes, chain length, alternative substrates and resident organisms constrain the response. A supplied inulin substrate is not an indispensable intake, a guaranteed abundance shift, butyrate yield, mucus effect or clinical benefit.

canonical_relationships.operation: Maintain short-chain fatty acid production and signalling that supports gut barrier and brain communication.

scientific_assessment.operation: Maintain short-chain fatty acid production and signalling that supports gut barrier and brain communication.
scientific_assessment.assessment_limitations: Culture conditions and community composition constrain production. Human inulin tracer estimates depend on assumed systemic availability; the human chicory-inulin trial did not significantly increase faecal butyrate. No fixed food yield, intake target or brain benefit is established.

food_target_research.sufficient_coverage_rationale: Inspected canonical inulin and onion records and the existing food-research ledger. No structured long-chain-specific food edge currently exists; mixed-fructan presence is insufficient to invent one. Dietary ingredient supply is established by oral human studies; exact food chain-length coverage remains an explicit ontology gap.

functional_dependency.statement: Inulin supplies fermentable carbohydrate for SCFA-producing microbial capacity; product distribution depends on community and culture or host conditions.

dietary_supply.statement: Defined oral inulin exposures are documented in human studies, including 15 g with breakfast in PMID 26516911. A formulated inulin ingredient is not interchangeable with every fructan food or oligofructose-enriched blend.

mechanism_engagement.statement: Linoleic acid engages intestinal fatty-acid sensing and vagal/brainstem nutrient signalling in the tested mouse circuits.

dietary_exposure.statement: The identified fatty acid is present in verified food-composition records and reaches intestinal sensing through lipid digestion. The direct classification concerns the fatty-acid sensing input, not a downstream metabolite or a claim that ordinary meals reproduce the 10% experimental exposure.

targeted_searches.query: Linoleic acid food composition, chemical form and preparation; distinguish tested formulation
targeted_searches.outcome: Retrieve existing structured linoleic-acid edges; free fatty-acid stimulus differs from esterified fatty acids in foods.

scientific_assessment.assessment_limitations: This is physiological nutrient sensing, not a beneficial direction or a need to increase linoleic acid. Human food-level circuit responses, vagal tone, ADHD and clinical benefits were not established. Foods generally supply esterified fatty acids released during digestion; the experimental free-fatty-acid stimulus is not a demonstrated food effect. More signalling is not automatically better.

canonical_relationships.operation: Sustain insulin-sensitive glucose disposal so post-meal glucose clears efficiently without prolonged metabolic strain.

scientific_assessment.operation: Sustain insulin-sensitive glucose disposal so post-meal glucose clears efficiently without prolonged metabolic strain.
scientific_assessment.assessment_limitations: Preparation-, dose- and population-specific. The positive study used 30 g/day for four weeks in ten healthy participants; this is not an effective whole-food dose. Preserve the later 40 g/day type-2-diabetes null. SCFA mediation and universal benefit are unestablished; no brain or ADHD inference.

food_target_research.sufficient_coverage_rationale: Existing structured composition and provisional food research for this exact canonical input were inspected. Reuse these source/form-qualified foods; do not infer an effective food dose or invent additional relationships.

mechanism_engagement.statement: Defined oral resistant-starch supplementation modulated clamp-measured insulin sensitivity and post-meal forearm glucose clearance in a small human study.

dietary_exposure.statement: The dietary ingredient was administered orally and the same substrate class has form-dependent food-source records. Neither green-banana content nor cooling a food establishes equivalence to the tested resistant-starch supplement.

canonical_relationships.biological_role: Defined oral resistant-starch supplementation modulated clamp-measured insulin sensitivity and post-meal forearm glucose clearance in a small human study.

Preserve the later 40 g/day type-2-diabetes null. SCFA mediation and universal benefit are unestablished; no brain or ADHD inference.

scientific_assessment.operation: Regulate adipose-derived endocrine signalling and local glucocorticoid responsiveness to communicate metabolic state and coordinate hormonal adaptation.

mechanism_engagement.statement: Defined oral DHA changed the circulating adiponectin signal in selected human contexts. This endocrine-response proposition does not claim local secretion, synthesis or receptor engagement.

dietary_exposure.statement: Oral DHA was administered in a defined re-esterified-triglyceride supplement; enriched-oil and mixed fish-oil exposures are assessed separately. Existing food composition establishes dietary presence, not trial equivalence.

food_target_research.sufficient_coverage_rationale: Existing food composition records and structured DHA edges cover multiple animal foods and algal oil; source, material, preparation and presence records were examined separately. Unmapped existing composition observations stay provisional. No new food or food-effective quantity is invented; trial formulations are not treated as equivalent to ordinary foods.

scientific_assessment.scope: Circulating adipose-derived endocrine signal modulation, not local production or physiological/clinical improvement.

canonical_relationships.biological_role: Defined oral DHA exposures can modulate circulating adiponectin, an adipose-derived endocrine signal.
canonical_relationships.dietary_input_note: Type B regulatory relationship; no dietary necessity, brain efficacy or ordinary-food intervention equivalence.
canonical_relationships.limitation: Admission concerns a circulating hormone response in studied supplement/enriched-oil contexts. It does not establish adipose secretion, receptor sensitivity, universal benefit, ordinary-food efficacy or a food-effective dose. Mixture and carrier effects are not attributed to DHA alone; DHA-specific attribution uses the separate DHA-versus-EPA trial.
canonical_relationships.qualification: Type B regulatory relationship; no dietary necessity, brain efficacy or ordinary-food intervention equivalence.

explanation: Covered by verified power-qualified canonical food observations.

canonical_relationships.operation: Enable NAPE-to-NAE biosynthesis so endocannabinoidome signalling lipids remain available for stress and motivation regulation.

scientific_assessment.operation: Enable NAPE-to-NAE biosynthesis so endocannabinoidome signalling lipids remain available for stress and motivation regulation.

functional_dependency.statement: Dietary zinc supplies the binuclear catalytic metal centre of human NAPE-PLD, supporting N-acylethanolamine production capacity.

dietary_supply.statement: The same mineral has established dietary supply through the canonical composition records. Cellular uptake and homeostasis mediate enzyme loading; this is maintenance of capacity, not a claim that extra intake accelerates the reaction.

scientific_assessment.assessment_limitations: Human enzyme structure and catalysis establish the metal dependency, not dietary zinc-driven brain NAE flux or benefit above adequacy. Cellular zinc homeostasis and membrane substrate access constrain loading; no extra-zinc recommendation is established.

food_target_research.sufficient_coverage_rationale: Inspected existing structured composition records and provisional research coverage for the same mineral. Verified plant/animal sources are reused with preparation qualifiers; no new food edge, effective food dose or enzyme-response inference is created.

canonical_relationships.biological_role: Two active-site zinc ions support human NAPE-PLD hydrolysis.
canonical_relationships.dietary_input_note: 2026-10-26 recovery: admitted Type A capacity under the functional-dependency and dietary-supply gate. The original biochemical-only record and its rationale are preserved in the recovery history. No additional-intake efficacy is asserted.

canonical_relationships.operation: Sustain omega-3-derived ethanolamide production so endocannabinoidome neuromodulation stays supplied from dietary fat status.

scientific_assessment.operation: Sustain omega-3-derived ethanolamide production so endocannabinoidome neuromodulation stays supplied from dietary fat status.

functional_dependency.statement: Dietary DHA supplies the fatty-acyl substrate for the PM’s omega-3 ethanolamide-production operation, including incorporation into N-docosahexaenoyl-PE and synaptamide formation.

dietary_supply.statement: The same mineral has established dietary supply through the canonical composition records. Cellular uptake and homeostasis mediate enzyme loading; this is maintenance of capacity, not a claim that extra intake accelerates the reaction.

scientific_assessment.assessment_limitations: Labelled neural-cell precursor experiments support formation; controlled oral-oil studies support corresponding plasma ethanolamide availability. Plasma concentration is not neuronal synthesis flux or receptor engagement, and no ordinary-food effective dose or clinical benefit is established. Direct is relative to this biosynthetic operation, not direct food content of synaptamide.

food_target_research.sufficient_coverage_rationale: Inspected existing structured composition records and provisional research coverage for the same mineral. Verified plant/animal sources are reused with preparation qualifiers; no new food edge, effective food dose or enzyme-response inference is created.

canonical_relationships.biological_role: DHA supplies the acyl chain used to form N-docosahexaenoyl-PE and synaptamide.
canonical_relationships.dietary_input_note: 2026-10-26: existing Direct capacity overlay and canonical source record retained; missing dietary-applicability field resolved under an explicit Type A assessment. Direct is relative to ethanolamide production, not direct metabolite content of food.
canonical_relationships.limitation: Labelled neural-cell precursor experiments support formation; controlled oral-oil studies support corresponding plasma ethanolamide availability. canonical_relationships.operation: Sustain omega-3-derived ethanolamide production so endocannabinoidome neuromodulation stays supplied from dietary fat status.

scientific_assessment.operation: Sustain omega-3-derived ethanolamide production so endocannabinoidome neuromodulation stays supplied from dietary fat status.

functional_dependency.statement: Dietary EPA supplies the fatty-acyl precursor for the corresponding EPEA-production arm of the PM’s omega-3 ethanolamide operation.

dietary_supply.statement: The same mineral has established dietary supply through the canonical composition records. Cellular uptake and homeostasis mediate enzyme loading; this is maintenance of capacity, not a claim that extra intake accelerates the reaction.

scientific_assessment.assessment_limitations: The oral EPA/DHA intervention evidence measures circulating corresponding ethanolamides, not neuronal synthesis rates or independent clinical mediation. Preserve active-arm, formulation and mixture limits. Direct refers to substrate provision to production; food EPA content is not food EPEA content or a quantified conversion yield.

food_target_research.sufficient_coverage_rationale: Inspected existing structured composition records and provisional research coverage for the same mineral. functional_dependency.statement: Dietary zinc maintains the metal pool supporting the androgen receptor’s zinc-finger DNA-binding capacity.
